Splitting into 5 separate vaults demands a separate funded dune account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the oasis binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 199 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
